raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Add ep_overlap_unpaired_layer_post_process (default off). When the forward and backward chunks of a combined 1F1B step have different layer counts, the extra layers run unpaired and their EP dispatch/combine is exposed. With the flag, the other microbatch's post-process (output layer + loss) fills the first unpaired layer's comm window: the backward output-layer backward runs during the dispatch of the first unpaired forward layer (unpaired forward layers now run first), or the forward output-layer forward runs during the combine backward of the first unpaired backward layer. TransformerLayerSchedulePlan.run gains an optional fill_comm_window callback for unpaired layers. Only the order changes.

Adds a parity test for [2,1], [3,1], [1,2], [1,3] and [1,1] chunks with and without MTP.

     """
 
+    ep_overlap_unpaired_layer_post_process: bool = False
+    """With EP overlap, hide the EP communication of an unpaired layer behind the post-process
+    (output layer + loss) of the other microbatch.
+    When the forward and backward model chunks of a 1F1B step have different layer counts, the
+    extra layers run without a partner and their dispatch/combine is exposed. With this flag:
+    - if the backward chunk has the post-process and fewer layers, its output-layer backward
+      runs in the dispatch window of the first unpaired forward layer, and the unpaired forward
+      layers run before the paired ones;
+    - if the forward chunk has the post-process and fewer layers, its output-layer forward runs
+      in the combine-backward window of the first unpaired backward layer.
+    Only the execution order changes; the computed values are the same.
+    """
